selected_fields.reason: GO-3b for the 2026-07-25 UTC day at a DISK-DERIVED cap of <=120,000 games, NOT the nominal 150,000. Roach flagged (00:11Z) that the two standing rules are arithmetically incompatible at full utilisation and declined to launch toward an unreachable number: V: 165.5 GiB free - 60.0 GiB standing disk floor = 105.5 GiB usable / ~0.79 MB per game ~= 136,700 games before the floor, against a nominal cap of 150,000 (~118 GB) = ~13 GB overshoot. Unattended, that surfaces as a disk-full incident at ~137k games mid-run. 120,000 holds ~14 GB of margin for the shard tail and the ram_watch soft-stop. GENERAL RULE BOUND BY THIS ENTRY: a per-UTC-day game cap is an UPPER bound that is always subordinate to the disk floor; the binding cap is min(nominal, disk-derived), recomputed from measured free space at launch, never the nominal alone. Preconditions unchanged: two-phase launch (announce intent, re-read this file, start from game 1), atomic per-shard checkpoint, preemptible, no double-run of selfplay_gen. Roach box only - this entry grants nothing on Skynet, whose commit envelope shrank ~42 GiB across the P0 restart (85.16 GiB limit vs 127.16 GiB during the overnight incident).

excerpt_lines.text:
## 2. The screening instrument — MEASURED

`sigma_delta` from 120,000 engine games, true mirror (`rules_lucario` vs itself, seats
alternated, p = 0.5 by symmetry), unpaired — the engine exposes no seed on the Windows ship
ABI (`probe_cg_seed.py`), so `Cov = 0` is an engine fact, not an assumption.

| n/arm | single-arm SD | sigma_delta | sqrt(2)*SD | binomial SD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | 0.02623 | **0.03529** | 0.03709 | 0.02500 |
| 1200 | 0.01725 | **0.02520** | 0.02439 | 0.01443 |
| 2400 | 0.01203 | **0.01626** | 0.01702 | 0.01021 |

The `sqrt(2)` match proves **Cov(arms) = 0** — independence, no cross-arm leak. It is
scale-free and does **not** prove binomiality.

result: The recovered completion status concerns July 25 seq-53, GO-3b selfplay corpus on ROACH. Its allocation is a disk-derived daily cap. These are status/allocation evidence, not primary game outputs or a sigma calculation. The August 6 mirror-calibration claim remains unlinked to this corpus.
lesson: Join studies by purpose, product, host, date, producer and primary receipt, never by game count alone. Do not substitute this corpus or the separate 6000-game A/A summary for the missing calibration.
limits: This does not prove the August calibration never ran.
No exhaustive remote-host, orphan-object, issue-comment or filesystem search was performed.
Status claims of completion and zero errors were not independently verified against primary corpus bytes.
Original scientific claims and current retractions remain unchanged.
